chapters.reason: The paper focuses on dynamic compute allocation during inference using confidence-based metrics to decide when to stop reasoning, which is a core aspect of test-time scaling.
The paper implements early exit mechanisms to manage the length of reasoning chains, effectively budgeting computational resources at inference time.
The paper integrates the Certaindex metric into a real-world LLM serving system (Dynasor) to improve throughput and efficiency in practical deployment scenarios.
